algerianRecipes.title: Authentic Algerian Cuisine
algerianRecipes.description: Traditional recipes from Algeria featuring Mediterranean, Berber, and Arab influences

breakfast.name: Tamina (Semolina Porridge)
instructions: Toast flour and semolina separately in pan until golden
In another pan, melt butter and mix in toasted flour and semolina
Stir constantly for 3-4 minutes until well combined and golden
Form into a mound on plate
Create a well in center and pour warm honey into it
Sprinkle with cinnamon, dates, and almonds
Serve warm
breakfast.notes: Traditional breakfast eaten during Ramadan and special occasions
breakfast.culturalSignificance: Symbol of hospitality and celebration in Algerian culture

breakfast.name: Msemen (Fried Algerian Pancake)
instructions: Mix flour and salt in bowl
Add warm water gradually, kneading until smooth dough forms
Let rest 10 minutes
Divide into 6 balls
Roll each ball very thin (almost transparent)
Brush generously with melted butter
Fold into thirds both ways, creating square
Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy (2-3 minutes per side)
Drain on paper towels
Serve hot with honey
breakfast.notes: Can be savory with cheese and herbs or sweet with honey

breakfast.name: Chorba Frik (Green Wheat Soup)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Sauté onions and garlic until golden
Add meat and brown on all sides (8-10 minutes)
Stir in tomato paste, harissa, and caraway seeds
Cook 2 minutes until fragrant
Add broth and bring to boil
Add green wheat and reduce heat
Simmer 30-35 minutes until wheat and meat are tender
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot
breakfast.notes: Traditional breakfast soup, especially popular in winter and Ramadan

breakfast.name: Khlis (Algerian Churros)
instructions: Mix flour, salt, and sugar in bowl
Bring water to boil and add to flour mixture
Stir until a thick paste forms
Let cool slightly
Heat oil in deep pan to 350°F
Transfer paste to piping bag with large star tip
Pipe 4-5 inch long strips directly into hot oil
Fry 2-3 minutes per side until golden
Drain on paper towels
Serve warm with honey and cinnamon
breakfast.notes: Similar to Spanish churros, beloved street food in Algeria

breakfast.name: Aghroum (Algerian Barley Bread)
instructions: Mix both flours, salt, sugar, and baking powder
Add warm water and olive oil
Knead into soft dough (don't overwork)
Let rest 10 minutes
Divide into 4 portions
Shape into flat rounds about 1/4 inch thick
Heat oil in large skillet
Fry each round 5-7 minutes per side until puffy and golden
Serve hot with butter and honey
breakfast.notes: Nutritious traditional bread made with barley flour

breakfast.name: Beghrir (Thousand-Hole Pancake)
instructions: Mix flour, semolina, baking powder, and salt
Add warm water and oil, stirring to form thin batter
Let rest 5 minutes
Heat non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
Pour 1/2 cup batter in center, lift pan and tilt to spread
Cook 2-3 minutes without flipping until holes form on top
Transfer to plate
Repeat with remaining batter
Serve hot with melted butter and honey
breakfast.notes: Distinctive pancake with honeycomb-like holes, soaks up butter and honey

breakfast.name: Makla (Algerian Omelette)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet
Sauté onion, pepper, and garlic until soft
Beat eggs with salt and pepper
Pour eggs over vegetables
Cook until edges begin to set
Sprinkle with parsley
Fold omelette in half when mostly cooked
Serve hot with crusty bread

breakfast.name: Ftira (Algerian Bread Salad)
instructions: Toast bread cubes in oven or pan until crispy
Combine tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, and onion
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper
Toss vegetables with dressing
Add bread cubes and mix well
Let sit 5 minutes for flavors to meld
Garnish with fresh herbs
Serve immediately
breakfast.notes: Similar to Italian panzanella, great way to use stale bread

breakfast.name: Ghrayef (Algerian Crepes)
instructions: Mix flour and salt
Add oil and water gradually to form thin batter
Let rest 10 minutes
Heat non-stick skillet or crepe pan
Pour small amount of batter, tilt to spread thin
Cook 1-2 minutes until set
Flip and cook other side briefly
Brush with butter
Fold and serve with honey or jam
breakfast.notes: Delicate crepes often served at celebrations

breakfast.name: Soupe à l'Oignon (Onion Soup)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Add sliced onions and cook over medium-low heat 15-20 minutes until golden and caramelized
Add garlic and cook 1 minute
Add vegetable broth and caraway seeds
Bring to boil, then simmer 10 minutes
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot with crusty bread
Optional: add cheese on bread and place in bowl
breakfast.notes: Hearty, warming soup perfect for cold mornings

breakfast.name: Tlitli (Algerian Pasta)
instructions: Mix flour and salt
Add water gradually to form stiff dough
Knead until smooth
Let rest 10 minutes
Roll out thin and break into irregular pasta-like pieces
Heat olive oil in large pot
Sauté garlic, caraway seeds, and harissa
Add vegetable broth and bring to boil
Add pasta pieces and cook 15 minutes until soft
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with cilantro
breakfast.notes: Hand-torn pasta dish, humble and comforting

breakfast.name: Kemia (Algerian Appetizers)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet
Brown merguez slices
Add onion and garlic, cook until soft
Add chickpeas, red pepper, paprika, and harissa
Simmer 10 minutes until vegetables are tender
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with cilantro
Serve warm with bread
breakfast.notes: Tapas-style appetizer platter, great for sharing

breakfast.name: Lsa'ada (Algerian Breakfast Salad)
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion in bowl
Mix harissa with olive oil and vinegar
Pour dressing over vegetables
Season with salt and pepper
Toss well
Top with fresh herbs and black olives
Serve at room temperature
breakfast.notes: Fresh, bright salad perfect for morning

breakfast.name: Shlada (Tunisian-Algerian Salad)
instructions: Arrange tomato slices on platter
Top with boiled egg slices
Drain tuna and flake over eggs
Scatter red onion, capers, and olives
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper
Pour dressing over salad
Garnish with fresh parsley
Serve immediately
breakfast.notes: Protein-rich salad combining vegetables, eggs, and fish

breakfast.name: Chorba Belanja (Chickpea Soup)
instructions: If using dried chickpeas, cook until tender (1-2 hours) and drain
Heat olive oil in large pot
Sauté onions and garlic until golden
Add tomato paste, paprika, and caraway seeds
Cook 2 minutes until fragrant
Add vegetable broth, chickpeas, and carrots
Stir in harissa
Simmer 25-30 minutes until carrots are tender
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh cilantro
Serve hot with bread
breakfast.notes: Nutritious chickpea soup, popular during Ramadan

lunch.name: Couscous aux Sept Légumes (Couscous with Seven Vegetables)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Brown meat on all sides
Add onion and cook until softened
Stir in tomato paste, ginger, turmeric, and saffron
Add broth and bring to boil
Add carrots, turnips, and simmer 20 minutes
Add zucchini, tomatoes, and chickpeas
Simmer another 20 minutes until vegetables are tender
Meanwhile, prepare couscous per package directions
Fluff couscous with butter and fork
Mound couscous on serving platter
Arrange vegetables around couscous
Pour broth over top
Serve hot
lunch.notes: Algeria's national dish, served at celebrations and Friday family meals
lunch.culturalSignificance: Central to Algerian food culture and hospitality

lunch.name: Tajine (Algerian Stew)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Brown meat thoroughly on all sides
Remove meat and set aside
In same pot, sauté onions and garlic until golden
Add tomato paste, paprika, cumin, cinnamon, and harissa
Cook 2 minutes until fragrant
Return meat to pot
Add beef broth and bring to simmer
Cover and cook 30 minutes
Add potatoes and carrots
Cook another 25-30 minutes until vegetables are tender
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot over couscous or with bread
lunch.notes: Simple but flavorful stew with warm spices

lunch.name: Shakshuka
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet
Sauté onion and garlic until golden
Add peppers and cook 5 minutes
Stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes
Add crushed tomatoes, cumin, paprika, and harissa
Simmer 10 minutes until sauce thickens
Create 6 wells in sauce
Crack egg into each well
Cover skillet and cook 8-10 minutes until eggs are set to desired doneness
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh herbs
Serve in same skillet with bread for dipping
lunch.notes: Popular throughout North Africa, often served with crusty bread

lunch.name: Dolma (Stuffed Vegetables)
instructions: Mix ground beef, cooked rice, onion, garlic, mint, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper
Hollow out tomatoes or peppers carefully
Fill each halves with meat mixture
Heat olive oil in large pot
Arrange stuffed vegetables seam-side up
Mix tomato sauce and vegetable broth
Pour sauce around vegetables
Cover and simmer 40-45 minutes until vegetables are tender
Serve hot or at room temperature
lunch.notes: Can also be made with zucchini or eggplant

lunch.name: Tabbouleh (Herb and Grain Salad)
instructions: In large bowl, combine bulgur, parsley, and mint
Add tomatoes, cucumber, and green onions
In small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper
Pour dressing over salad and toss well
Let sit 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend
Serve on lettuce leaves as a side dish
Can be made ahead and refrigerated
lunch.notes: Refreshing salad with herbaceous, lemony flavor

lunch.name: Mmounis (Chickpea Pasta)
instructions: Mix chickpea flour, all-purpose flour, and salt
Add water gradually to form soft dough
Knead until smooth
Roll out thin and cut into small irregular shapes
Heat oil and deep fry pasta pieces 2-3 minutes until golden
Drain on paper towels
In separate pot, heat olive oil
Sauté garlic and harissa
Add crushed tomatoes and caraway seeds
Simmer 15 minutes
Toss fried pasta with sauce
Garnish with cilantro

lunch.name: Mermez (Bean Stew)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Sauté onions and garlic until golden
Add tomato paste, paprika, cumin, and harissa
Cook 2 minutes
Add vegetable broth, beans, diced tomatoes, and carrots
Bring to boil, then reduce heat
Simmer 40 minutes until carrots are tender and flavors blend
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh parsley
Serve with crusty bread

lunch.name: Tine Taarif (Beet and Carrot Salad)
instructions: Cook beets and carrots until tender
Cut into cubes and place in bowl
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, garlic, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper
Pour dressing over vegetables
Toss gently to combine
Let sit 15 minutes
Garnish with fresh cilantro
Drizzle with lemon juice before serving
lunch.notes: Colorful, nutritious salad with earthy flavors

lunch.name: Kasbah (Meat and Vegetable Stew)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Brown meat on all sides
Remove meat and set aside
In same pot, sauté onions and garlic until golden
Add tomato paste, paprika, cumin, cinnamon, and harissa
Cook 2 minutes
Return meat to pot
Add beef broth and crushed tomatoes
Bring to boil, then reduce heat
Simmer 45 minutes
Add potatoes and peppers
Cook another 30 minutes until vegetables are tender
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot
lunch.notes: Hearty fortress-style stew with warm spices

lunch.name: Quiches aux Épinards (Spinach Quiche)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F
Heat olive oil in skillet
Sauté onion and garlic until soft
Add spinach and cook until wilted
Drain well if wet
Place pie crust in pie dish
Spread cooked spinach mixture in crust
Whisk together eggs, cream, cheese, salt, pepper, and nutmeg
Pour egg mixture over spinach
Bake 35-40 minutes until center is set and top is golden
Let cool 5 minutes before slicing
lunch.notes: French-influenced lunch dish popular in Algeria

lunch.name: Soupe d'Orge (Barley Soup)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until slightly soft
Add barley and stir for 2 minutes
Add vegetable broth, thyme, and bay leaf
Bring to boil, then reduce heat
Simmer 45-50 minutes until barley is tender
Season with salt and pepper
Remove bay leaf
Garnish with fresh parsley
Serve hot
lunch.notes: Nutritious, satisfying soup with chewy barley

lunch.name: Lentilles Jaunes (Yellow Lentil Soup)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups yellow split peas or lentils
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Sauté onion and garlic until golden
Add turmeric and cumin, cook 1 minute
Add lentils, carrots, and vegetable broth
Bring to boil, then reduce heat
Simmer 30-35 minutes until lentils are very soft
Blend partially for creamier texture if desired
Add lemon juice
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh cilantro
lunch.notes: Creamy, protein-rich soup with warm spices

lunch.name: Gratin Végétal (Vegetable Gratin)
ingredients: 1 cup béchamel sauce or heavy cream
Salt, pepper, and herbs to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F
Brush vegetable slices with olive oil and season
Arrange in layers in baking dish
Scatter garlic and onion throughout
Pour béchamel sauce or cream over vegetables
Top with grated cheese
Bake 40-45 minutes until vegetables are tender and top is golden
Let rest 5 minutes before serving

lunch.name: Harissa (Red Pepper Paste)
instructions: Remove stems and seeds from chili peppers
Soak peppers in hot water for 15 minutes until soft
Drain and squeeze out excess water
Combine soaked peppers, garlic, caraway seeds, coriander seeds, and salt in food processor
Process until smooth paste forms
Add olive oil and lemon juice
Process until well combined
Transfer to jar and refrigerate
Serve with couscous, bread, or mixed into soups and stews
lunch.notes: Essential condiment in Algerian cuisine, stores well for months

lunch.name: Omelette Algérienne (Algerian Omelette)
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in skillet
Cook diced potato until almost done (5 minutes)
Add red pepper and onion, cook 3 minutes
Add browned merguez and cook 1 minute
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper
Push vegetables to side, add remaining oil
Pour eggs over vegetables
Cook until eggs begin to set
Fold omelette when mostly cooked
Slide onto plate
Garnish with cilantro
Serve with harissa on the side
lunch.notes: Hearty omelette loaded with vegetables and sausage

dinner.name: Merguez with Harissa
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet
Brown merguez sausages on all sides (about 8 minutes)
Remove sausages and set aside
In same skillet, sauté onion and garlic until golden
Stir in harissa paste and cumin
Cook 2 minutes until fragrant
Add crushed tomatoes and beef broth
Return sausages to skillet
Simmer 10 minutes until sauce reduces slightly
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot with crusty bread or couscous
Garnish with fresh cilantro
dinner.notes: Spicy merguez sausages are beloved in Algerian cuisine

dinner.name: Rfissa (Chicken and Lentil Stew)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Brown chicken pieces on all sides
Remove chicken and set aside
In same pot, sauté onions and garlic until golden
Add tomato paste, turmeric, and ginger
Cook 2 minutes until fragrant
Return chicken to pot
Add lentils and chicken broth
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer
Add tomatoes and cilantro
Cook 60-70 minutes until lentils are tender and chicken is cooked
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot with lemon wedges and bread
dinner.notes: Nutritious and comforting stew with protein from chicken and lentils

dinner.name: Pastilla (Chicken Pie)
instructions: Cook onion, garlic, cilantro, and parsley in butter until soft
Add shredded chicken and heat through
Stir in cinnamon, turmeric, salt, and pepper
Cook until mixture is dry
Preheat oven to 350°F
Lay one phyllo sheet and brush lightly with oil
Layer 2-3 more phyllo sheets, brushing each
Spread chicken mixture over phyllo
Sprinkle with almonds
Fold phyllo edges over filling
Continue layering remaining phyllo, brushing with oil between layers
Place seam-side down on baking sheet
Brush top with beaten egg
Bake 45-50 minutes until golden brown
Dust with powdered sugar and cinnamon
Serve warm or at room temperature
dinner.notes: Moroccan/Algerian delicacy, traditionally served at celebrations

dinner.name: Roasted Lamb with Rosemary and Garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F
Make slits in lamb and insert garlic slices and rosemary sprigs
Rub lamb with olive oil, mustard, salt, and pepper
Place lamb in roasting pan
Arrange onions, carrots, and potatoes around lamb
Pour beef broth in pan
Roast uncovered 80-90 minutes (medium-rare to medium)
Baste with pan juices every 20 minutes
Let rest 10 minutes before carving
Drizzle with lemon juice
Serve with roasted vegetables and pan juices
dinner.notes: Elegant main dish perfect for special occasions

dinner.name: Chorba (Traditional Vegetable Soup)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Brown meat on all sides
Add onions and garlic, cook until golden
Stir in tomato paste, harissa, paprika, and caraway seeds
Cook 2 minutes until fragrant
Add beef broth and crushed tomatoes
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer
Add carrots, zucchini, and chickpeas
Simmer 30-35 minutes until vegetables are tender
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro
dinner.notes: Hearty soup served year-round, especially popular during Ramadan

dinner.name: Grilled Fish with Charmoula
ingredients: 4 whole fish or thick fillets (sea bream, grouper, or snapper)
instructions: Make charmoula: combine cilantro, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, paprika, cumin, cayenne, salt, and pepper
Score fish skin diagonally
Place fish in shallow dish
Pour half of charmoula over fish
Let marinate 15 minutes
Heat grill or grill pan to high heat
Grill fish 8-10 minutes per side until cooked through
Transfer to serving platter
Pour remaining charmoula over fish
Serve with lemon wedges
dinner.notes: Charmoula is versatile sauce used throughout North Africa

dinner.name: Kebab aux Légumes (Vegetable Kebab)
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper
Toss vegetables with marinade
Thread vegetables onto skewers, alternating types
Heat grill or grill pan to high heat
Grill kebabs 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until vegetables are charred and tender
Garnish with fresh herbs
Serve with couscous or rice

dinner.name: Steak Frit (Fried Steak with Fries)
instructions: Cut potatoes into fries and soak in water for 10 minutes
Drain and pat dry
Heat oil to 350°F
Fry potatoes in batches until golden (8-10 minutes)
Drain on paper towels, season with salt
Heat butter in large skillet
Season steaks with salt and pepper
Sear steaks 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare
Top with minced garlic in final minute
Serve steaks with fries
Garnish with parsley
Serve with lemon wedges

dinner.name: Djaj Matisha (Tomato Chicken)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Brown chicken pieces on all sides
Remove chicken and set aside
In same pot, sauté onions and garlic until golden
Add tomato paste, paprika, cumin, and harissa
Cook 2 minutes until fragrant
Add fresh tomatoes and chicken broth
Return chicken to pot
Cover and simmer 35-40 minutes until chicken is cooked
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh herbs
Serve with couscous or rice

dinner.name: Briouats (Meat Pastries)
instructions: Cook ground meat with onions and garlic until browned
Add cilantro, parsley, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper
Let cool slightly, then mix in beaten egg
Lay one phyllo sheet
Brush with oil
Place 2 tbsp filling near bottom corner
Fold corners over filling to create triangle or envelope shape
Continue folding and rolling to seal
Repeat with remaining sheets and filling
Deep fry in oil until golden on both sides
Drain on paper towels
Serve hot or warm
dinner.notes: Popular appetizer or light dinner, crispy and savory

dinner.name: Moussaka Algérienne
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F
Brush eggplant slices with oil and bake 15 minutes until soft
Brown ground meat, add onion and garlic
Add tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, paprika, cumin, cinnamon
Simmer 15 minutes until sauce reduces
In baking dish, layer eggplant, meat sauce, béchamel
Repeat layers, ending with béchamel
Top with grated cheese
Bake 35-40 minutes until golden and bubbly
Let rest 10 minutes before serving

dinner.name: Poisson Farci (Stuffed Fish)
instructions: Clean fish and pat dry
Mix breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, herbs, eggs, salt, and pepper
Stuff fish cavity with breadcrumb mixture
Place stuffed fish in baking dish
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice
Bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until fish is cooked
Garnish with lemon slices
Serve with roasted vegetables

dinner.name: Skewered Lamb Kebab
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cumin, harissa, salt, and pepper
Marinate lamb in mixture for 15 minutes
Thread lamb onto skewers alternating with onions and peppers
Heat grill or grill pan to high heat
Grill kebabs 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally
Lamb should be cooked but still slightly pink inside
Garnish with fresh mint and parsley
Serve with flatbread and yogurt sauce

dinner.name: Ratatouille Algérienne
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Sauté onion and garlic until golden
Add eggplants and cook 5 minutes
Add zucchini, peppers, and cook 5 minutes
Stir in tomato paste, paprika, cumin, and harissa
Add crushed tomatoes
Simmer 20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh herbs
Serve hot or at room temperature

dinner.name: Spaghetti à la Sauce Bolognaise
instructions: Heat olive oil in large pot
Brown ground beef with onion and garlic
Add tomato paste and cook 2 minutes
Add crushed tomatoes, red wine, paprika, and bay leaf
Simmer 25-30 minutes until sauce thickens
Season with salt and pepper
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti per package directions
Drain pasta and divide into serving bowls
Top with Bolognaise sauce
Sprinkle with grated cheese and fresh parsley
dinner.notes: Italian-influenced pasta dish popular in Algeria

dessert.name: Makrout (Semolina Cookies)
instructions: Mix semolina, flour, and baking powder in bowl
In another bowl, cream butter and sugar
Add vanilla to butter mixture
Combine flour mixture with butter mixture
Add warm water until dough is slightly moist but crumbly
Knead gently to form smooth dough
Roll out to 1/4 inch thickness
Cut into diamond shapes
Place whole clove on top of each
Heat oil to 350°F
Deep fry cookies 1-2 minutes per side until golden
Drain on paper towels
Heat honey with orange blossom water
Dip warm cookies in hot honey syrup
Arrange on serving platter
dessert.notes: Crispy outside, soft inside; soaked in sweet honey syrup

dessert.name: Gazelle Horns (Cornes de Gazelle)
instructions: Mix ground almonds, powdered sugar, cinnamon, and orange blossom water
Lay one phyllo sheet and brush lightly with oil
Place 1 tbsp almond mixture along one edge
Roll tightly to form horn shape
Curve slightly into crescent shape
Place on baking sheet seam-side down
Brush with egg white
Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes until golden
Dust generously with powdered sugar while warm
Cool on wire rack
dessert.notes: Delicate pastry, named for their gazelle horn shape

dessert.name: M'hanncha (Snake Cake)
instructions: Roll marzipan into a long rope (about 1/2 inch thick)
Layer 5 phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter
Place marzipan rope at bottom of layered phyllo
Roll tightly, keeping roll straight
Coil the rolled phyllo into a spiral (like a snake) on baking sheet
Brush top with melted butter
Bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes until golden
Sprinkle with cinnamon and powdered sugar while warm
Drizzle with orange blossom water
Decorate with whole almonds in a pattern

dessert.name: Loukoum (Turkish Delight)
ingredients: 1 tbsp rose water or orange blossom water
Powdered sugar mixed with cornstarch (for coating)
instructions: Mix cornstarch and flour in large saucepan
Gradually whisk in water to form smooth paste
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly
In separate saucepan, dissolve sugar in water with lemon juice
Add cream of tartar and bring to boil
Remove from heat and let cool slightly
Slowly pour sugar syrup into cornstarch mixture, stirring constantly
Cook 30-40 minutes, stirring frequently, until mixture is thick and pale
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and rose water
Pour into greased 8x8 inch pan
Smooth the top
Cool completely (at least 2 hours)
Cut into 1-inch squares
Coat in powdered sugar-cornstarch mixture
Top with crushed nuts
dessert.notes: Chewy, fragrant confection beloved throughout North Africa

dessert.name: Baklava
instructions: Mix chopped nuts with sugar and cinnamon
Preheat oven to 350°F
Brush bottom of 9x13 inch pan with melted butter
Layer 5 phyllo sheets, brushing each with butter
Spread thin layer of nut mixture
Repeat layering phyllo and nuts, ending with phyllo
Brush top generously with butter
Cut into diamond or square shapes before baking
Place one clove in center of each piece
Bake 35-40 minutes until golden brown
While baking, heat honey with lemon juice, orange blossom water, and cinnamon stick
When baklava is hot from oven, pour warm honey syrup over
Let cool completely before serving
dessert.notes: Crispy, sweet pastry soaked in honey syrup

dessert.name: Qassida (Almond Paste Cookies)
instructions: Mix ground almonds with sugar
Add egg white, orange blossom water, and rose water
Knead until mixture holds together
Roll into balls and flatten into oval shapes
Top each cookie with a whole almond
Heat oil to 350°F
Deep fry cookies 2-3 minutes until lightly golden
Drain on paper towels
Dip into warm honey
Serve warm or at room temperature
dessert.notes: Almond-based cookies with fragrant floral flavors

dessert.name: Chibani (Old-Fashioned Cake)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F
Grease and flour 9x13 inch cake pan
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
Add eggs one at a time, beating well
Combine flour, baking powder, and baking soda
Alternate adding flour mixture and yogurt to butter mixture
Add vanilla, orange blossom water, and orange zest
Pour into prepared pan
Bake 40-45 minutes until toothpick comes out clean
Cool in pan before turning out
Serve plain or with mint tea
dessert.notes: Traditional Algerian sponge cake, humble but delicious

dessert.name: Charak (Date Paste Candy)
instructions: Process dates in food processor until smooth paste forms
Heat butter slightly until soft
Mix dates with butter, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt
Shape into small balls or log shapes
Refrigerate for 1 hour
Roll in powdered sugar
Top with whole almond or pistachio
Store in airtight container in refrigerator
dessert.notes: Rich, easy candy perfect for gifts

dessert.name: Zgougou (Chickpea Fritter)
ingredients: 2 tbsp vegetable oil (plus more for frying)
instructions: Mix chickpea flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt
Add warm water, oil, and orange blossom water
Stir until thick batter forms
Heat oil for frying
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil
Fry 2-3 minutes until golden and puffed
Drain on paper towels
Drizzle with honey
Sprinkle with sesame seeds
Serve warm
dessert.notes: Puffy, honey-drizzled fritter, popular during Ramadan

dessert.name: Pâte de Fruits (Fruit Paste)
ingredients: 2 cups unsweetened fruit purée (apricot or plum)
Sugar or powdered sugar for dusting
instructions: Combine fruit purée, sugar, lemon juice, and water in heavy pot
Bring to boil over medium-high heat
Reduce heat and simmer 20-25 minutes, stirring frequently
Mixture should be very thick and pull away from sides of pot
Pour into parchment-lined 8x8 inch pan
Let cool completely and set (at least 24 hours)
Cut into 1-inch squares
Dust with sugar or powdered sugar
Store in airtight container
dessert.notes: Sophisticated fruit candy, perfect with mint tea

dessert.name: Sfenj (Algerian Donut)
ingredients: 1 tbsp vegetable oil (plus more for frying)
instructions: Mix flour, salt, baking powder, and sugar
Add warm water and oil gradually, stirring to form thin batter
Heat oil for frying to 350°F
Using two spoons or a special sfenj tool, create donut shapes
Drop into hot oil and fry until golden
Flip and fry other side
Drain on paper towels
Dip in honey while still warm
Serve immediately
dessert.notes: Puffy, hole-less donut dipped in honey

dessert.name: Griwech (Sesame Cookies)
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt
Add melted butter, oil, and vanilla
Knead into soft dough
Roll out thin and cut into strips
Brush strips with egg white
Sprinkle generously with sesame seeds
Heat oil for frying
Deep fry strips 2-3 minutes until golden
Drain on paper towels
Drizzle with honey
Cool before serving
dessert.notes: Crispy, sesame-coated cookies, popular at celebrations

dessert.name: Croquante (Brittle Candy)
instructions: Heat sugar, honey, and water in heavy pot
Cook to hard-crack stage (300-310°F on candy thermometer)
Stir in nuts, butter, vanilla, and salt
Working quickly, pour onto oiled marble or parchment
Let cool completely
Break into bite-sized pieces
Store in airtight container

dessert.name: Milles Feuilles (Thousand Leaves)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F
Cut puff pastry into three equal rectangles
Brush lightly with butter
Bake 30-35 minutes until golden and puffed
Meanwhile, make pastry cream: heat milk with sugar
Mix cornstarch with 1/4 cup cold milk
Temper cornstarch mixture in hot milk
Cook 2-3 minutes until thickened
Add vanilla and cool completely
Layer pastry sheets with pastry cream
Dust top with powdered sugar
Drizzle with melted chocolate
dessert.notes: Classic French-influenced pastry popular in Algeria

dessert.name: Dates Stuffed with Almond Paste
instructions: Mix ground almonds with powdered sugar, orange blossom water, and cinnamon
Pit dates carefully, keeping hole as small as possible
Pipe or stuff almond paste into each date
Top with whole almond
Dust lightly with cocoa powder
Arrange on serving platter
Serve at room temperature
dessert.notes: Elegant, simple treat combining two beloved ingredients

snacks.name: Zlabia (Fried Pastry)
instructions: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder
Add warm water gradually, stirring to form thin batter
Let batter rest 10 minutes
Heat oil to 350°F
Transfer batter to squeeze bottle or churrera
Squeeze long, wavy strips directly into oil
Fry 2-3 minutes until golden on one side
Flip and fry another minute until golden
Remove with slotted spoon
Immediately dip into warm honey
Arrange on platter
Sprinkle with pistachios or sesame seeds
Serve warm
snacks.notes: Sticky-sweet pastry popular at cafes and during Ramadan

snacks.name: Kaak (Algerian Ring Bread)
instructions: Mix flour, semolina, salt, and baking powder
Make well in center
Add oil and warm water
Knead into soft, smooth dough
Let rest 10 minutes
Divide dough into 8 equal portions
Roll each into rope and form into ring shape
Press sesame seeds onto each ring
Heat oil to 350°F
Deep fry rings 2-3 minutes per side until golden
Drain on paper towels
Serve warm, optionally dipped in honey
snacks.notes: Beloved breakfast bread or snack, often served with coffee

snacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas
instructions: Pat chickpeas dry with paper towels
Toss with olive oil
Mix paprika, cumin, salt, pepper, and cayenne in small bowl
Add spices to chickpeas and toss to coat
Spread on baking sheet in single layer
Roast at 400°F for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway
Chickpeas should be golden and crispy
Cool on baking sheet (they crisp up more as they cool)
Store in airtight container

snacks.name: Tripe Sandwich (Sandwich Merguez)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet
Add tripe and cook 5 minutes until surface browns
Add onion and garlic, cook until soft
Stir in harissa, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper
Add 1/4 cup water to make sauce
Simmer 15-20 minutes until tripe is tender
Toast baguette halves
Fill baguettes with tripe mixture
Top with fresh cilantro
Serve with lemon wedges on the side
snacks.notes: Popular street food sandwich, delicious and economical

snacks.name: Roasted Almonds with Spices
instructions: Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat
Add almonds and toast 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently
Mix salt, paprika, cinnamon, and cayenne in small bowl
Sprinkle spices over almonds and stir to coat
Drizzle with honey and continue stirring
Cook another 3-4 minutes until fragrant
Spread on parchment paper to cool
Break apart as they cool
Store in airtight container
snacks.notes: Sweet and savory snack perfect with tea or coffee

snacks.name: Chilla (Algerian Crepes)
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, and salt
Whisk together eggs and water
Combine dry and wet ingredients to form thin batter
Heat oil in non-stick pan over medium heat
Pour batter and tilt pan to spread thin
Cook 1-2 minutes until golden
Fold in half
Serve warm with honey or jam

snacks.name: Tamer (Date Paste)
instructions: Process dates in food processor until smooth
Add butter, argan oil, cinnamon, and salt
Process until well combined
Transfer to serving bowl
Serve with crusty bread for spreading
Can be made ahead and refrigerated
snacks.notes: Healthy date spread, traditional breakfast accompaniment

snacks.name: Sardine Sandwich
instructions: Drain sardines (reserve some oil)
Arrange tomato slices on baguette bottom
Top with sliced red onion
Add sardines
Sprinkle with fresh herbs
Add harissa to taste
Drizzle with lemon juice and reserved sardine oil
Close sandwich
Serve immediately

snacks.name: Olive and Almond Mix
instructions: Combine olives, almonds, and dried fruit in bowl
Whisk together olive oil, paprika, cumin, garlic, and salt
Pour dressing over snack mix
Toss well
Let sit 30 minutes for flavors to meld
Serve at room temperature
Can be made ahead and stored in refrigerator
snacks.notes: Healthy snack mix with briny, nutty, sweet flavors

snacks.name: Chorba Belanja (Dry Chickpea Snack)
instructions: Pat chickpeas dry with paper towels
Toss with olive oil and spices
Spread on baking sheet in single layer
Roast at 400°F for 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway
Chickpeas should be crispy
Cool on baking sheet
Store in airtight container
snacks.notes: Spiced crispy snack, more flavorful than basic roasted version

snacks.name: Kefta (Meatball Sandwich)
instructions: Mix ground meat, onion, garlic, cilantro, parsley, paprika, and cumin
Shape into oblong meatballs or patties
Heat olive oil in skillet
Cook kefta 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through
Slice baguette lengthwise
Fill with cooked kefta
Add tomato slices and harissa
Serve hot
snacks.notes: Spiced meatball sandwich, popular street food

snacks.name: Pignons (Pine Nut Snack)
instructions: Melt butter in skillet over medium heat
Add pine nuts and toast 5-7 minutes, stirring frequently
Sprinkle with salt and cayenne
Drizzle with honey
Cook 1-2 minutes until honey caramelizes
Spread on parchment to cool
Break apart and store in airtight container

snacks.name: Cheese and Fig Bites
ingredients: 200g soft cheese (feta, chèvre, or cream cheese)
instructions: Stuff each fig with about 1/2 tbsp cheese
Drizzle with honey
Sprinkle with crushed walnuts
Arrange on serving platter
Serve at room temperature
Can be made ahead and refrigerated
snacks.notes: Sweet and savory combination, elegant appetizer or snack

snacks.name: Tarte Flambée (Algerian Pizza)
ingredients: 1 cup crème fraîche or sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F
Brush crust with oil
Spread crème fraîche evenly
Layer onions and bacon
Top with grated cheese
Bake 15-20 minutes until crust is golden and cheese melted
Serve hot, cut into pieces

snacks.name: Zaalouk (Eggplant Dip)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet
Add diced eggplant and cook 10-15 minutes until soft
Add garlic, tomato paste, paprika, cumin, and harissa
Cook 10 more minutes until flavors blend
Mash eggplant to chunky consistency
Stir in fresh herbs
Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste
Serve warm or at room temperature
Serve with crusty bread for dipping
snacks.notes: Roasted eggplant dip, Moroccan influence but popular in Algeria
